SELECT login_fail_id, user_id, user_type, login_name, login_fail_count, CAST(lock_flag AS integer) AS lock_flag, login_lock_begin_time, create_time, update_time FROM t_login_fail
AND t_login_fail.login_name LIKE '%' || replace(replace(replace(#{queryForm.loginName}, '\', '\\'), '%', '\%'), '_', '\_') || '%'
AND t_login_fail.lock_flag = #{queryForm.lockFlag}
AND t_login_fail.login_lock_begin_time >= CAST(#{queryForm.loginLockBeginTimeBegin} AS date)
AND t_login_fail.login_lock_begin_time < CAST(#{queryForm.loginLockBeginTimeEnd} AS date) + INTERVAL '1 day'
order by t_login_fail.update_time desc
